mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) directly reduces the discount rate applied to equity cash flows, compressing valuation multiples and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low FEDFUNDS periods (FEDFUNDS < 4.5%) are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 0.5 percentage points over three months signals deteriorating labor market conditions and reduced consumer spending, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances (UNRATE rise > 0.5pp in 3 months), or the Rank IC between UNRATE change and 5d returns is negative in any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) indicate broad-based demand contraction, reducing corporate revenue visibility and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the interaction term (HOUST decline * RSAFS decline) has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, strong industrial production (INDPRO) above 105 signals robust manufacturing capacity and supply chain resilience, supporting corporate earnings growth and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 105 during late-cycle expansion, or the Rank IC between INDPRO and 20d returns is below 0.03 in the late-cycle regime.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL acceleration exceeding 0.3 percentage points over three months signals rising inflationary pressures, prompting aggressive monetary tightening and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL rise > 0.3pp in 3 months), or the Rank IC between CPIAUCSL change and 5d returns is negative in any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong non-farm payrolls growth (PAYEMS) directly supports consumer spending and corporate earnings momentum, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in high PAYEMS periods (PAYEMS growth > 0.5%) are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During post-recession recovery, positive GDP growth (GDPC1) above 1.5% annualized signals sustainable economic expansion and corporate profit growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth > 1.5% during post-recession recovery, or the Rank IC between GDPC1 growth and 20d returns is below 0.03 in the recovery regime.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate synchronized strength across manufacturing and construction sectors, boosting supply capacity and corporate earnings visibility, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of periods where both INDPRO and HOUST increase, or the interaction term (INDPRO increase * HOUST increase) has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year window.
